lineage.git_sha_reason: run ledger carries no source-tree SHA today (Goal 9 lineage add).

compat.relationship: The report pack is a SUPERSET of the existing RunReportData aggregate. summary.json's verdict/segments/cost_sensitivity blocks are field-compatible with RunReportData (api/routers/runs_report.py); the pack ADDS scorecards.json, metrics.json, gate_results.json and the file-level manifest that RunReportData does not carry. A frontend can render the pack from files, or read the aggregate JSON from the endpoint.
differences: RunReportData.monthly_returns uses a reconstructed business-day index (_MONTHLY_BASIS); the pack inherits the same disclosed approximation.
RunReportData carries no five-scorecard block; that is new in scorecards.json.
The pack exposes files+sha256 for lineage/caching; the endpoint returns an in-memory aggregate only.
